Modeled after the [[Eriadu strength amplifier]], these '''Power Gloves''', utilized by operatives of the [[GenoHaradan]], used bursts of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] energy to assist in movement, effectively giving the user tremendous strength.
